data.title: Lillia The Valley
data.about:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate luxury at Lillia! The opulent new homes in The Valley range from 3 to 4 bedrooms. The residences in the gated community come in two distinct architectural styles: Jade, boasting both warmth and fluidity and blending linear forms with elegant curves, and Pearl, which represents modern artistry with its edgy and sleek design. 

Emaar Lillia for sale also offers generous outdoor spaces, catering to those who value their home's internal and external aspects. Other amenities at Lillia The Valley townhouses include a swimming pool, a fitness center, outdoor play areas, and a social clubhouse. The Valley fosters a vibrant and engaging community environment, with lifestyle conveniences, educational institutions, healthcare services, and retail destinations all within easy reach.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury Living Nestled in a Green Surrounding
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• An elegant community ideally situated away from the hustle and bustle of the city yet conveniently close to vibrant destinations

  • Prospective homeowners can select from two unique architectural designs.
  • The Community Park & Golden Beach are just a few steps away.
  • Find the ideal harmony between nature and luxury.
  • Benefit from Emaar Properties' flexible payment options.

location_tile.title: Discover Peaceful Living Amidst Nature
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Conveniently positioned along the Dubai-Al Ain Road, the Emaar Lillia townhouse location provides effortless access to key areas of both emirates. Its abundance of green spaces further enhances its strategic allure, offering residents a harmonious blend of urban convenience and natural tranquility.

  • 05 Minutes - Rugby Sevens Stadium
  • 08 Minutes - Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 25 Minutes - Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
